description: Full block-tile shape sweep for inference (d=64, bf16, hstu). Sweeps sequence<kM0,kN0,kN0Sub,kN1,kK1,MaxK>: M=km0 {64,128,192}, N=kn0 {32,64,128}, K-stream=kn0sub+kk1 (must be equal; sweep kk1 {32,64}, kn0sub auto-matched in instance_gen gate), V head tile kn1 {16,32,64}. warp_k FORCED to 32 (16x16x32 MFMA): d=64 needs WarpK=32 to satisfy the pipeline WarpGemm assertion (WarpK=16/16x16x16 fails to compile), and kK1>=WarpK so kk1=16 is pruned by the instance_gen gate. Invalid combos skipped by instance_gen (kN0Sub==kK1, kN0%kK1==0, MaxK%kN1==0, kK1>=WarpK). splitkv combos with a tile override are skipped (split-KV dispatch can't honor tile shapes). Kernel names get _km0NNN _n0NNN _n0sNNN _n1NNN _k1NNN _wkNN tokens when overridden. Use --only-problem step5_infer_b120_n16384_h4.
